about: Curated CA trust incidents. Fingerprints are SHA-256 of the DER certificate, copied from the primary record named in 'reference'. Matching is by fingerprint only, never by CA name.

incidents.source: Mozilla Bugzilla 2083449 (eMudhra intermediate key compromise), cross-checked against the Chromium blocklist
incidents.summary: intermediate CA private keys were publicly recoverable (P-384 keys generated with tiny private values); revoked 2026-10-18 (caCompromise) and blocked by Chrome and Firefox
